cohort: 3,172 women who underwent major obstetric and gynecological surgeries at a tertiary referral hospital in Belagavi, Karnataka, India, from May 2016 to August 2017.
finding: The incidence of wound dehiscence following obstetric and gynecological surgeries was 3.05%, with a higher incidence following obstetric surgeries (84.54%) compared to gynecological surgeries (15.46%).
